newsitem.title: USA: Day Runner sees charges hurting Q3 net.
newsitem.headline: Day Runner sees charges hurting Q3 net.

text.p: Day Runner Inc said that, while it expects sales growth in the third quarter to exceed analysts' expectations, net income will be hurt by expenses it racked up pursuing acquisitions that did not come to fruition.
The company said that, without those costs, its earnings would have exceeded analyst forecasts of third quarter earnings of $0.12 to $0.13 per share.
It estimates the legal, advisory and accounting costs of two attempted acquisitions totaled about $1.5 million, or $0.13 per share.
In the year ago third quarter, Day Runner reported net income of $745,000, or $0.11 per share, on sales of about $18.1 million.
The company said it is confident that its sales in the latest third quarter will exceed analyst expectations of a 15 percent increase from last year.
The company cited renewed growth in its sales to Wal-Mart Stores Inc and increased sales to certain other large customers.
